title: A Survey on Large Language Model Benchmarks

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying benchmarks (such as CDEval and NORMAD-ETI) that utilize multilingual multiple-choice testing and classification tasks across diverse cultural dimensions and contexts to assess cultural adaptability and representation.

Analyzing cross-lingual benchmarks (such as Xtreme and MDIA) to measure performance discrepancies and typological inequities between high-resource analytic languages (like English) and lower-resource or morphologically rich agglutinative languages.

Reviewing safety and social adaptability benchmarks (such as SocialStigmaQA, StereoSet, and CrowS-Pairs) that use multiple-choice samples and paired sentence tests to uncover stigma amplification and stereotypical associations regarding specific demographic groups.
